name: one-arm-standing-arnold-press.html
instructions:
1. Grab a dumbbell and assume a shoulder-width stance.
2. Raise the dumbbell to around shoulder height, and rotate your wrist so that your palm is facing your body. You can place your other hand on your waist for support. This is the starting position.
3. Slowly press the dumbbell overhead by extending the elbows and contracting the deltoids. As you press, rotate the dumbbell until your palm is facing forward.
4. Once your arm is almost fully extended, begin lowering the dumbbell back down to the starting position - rotating your wrist until your palm is facing your body once again.
5. Repeat this movement for the desired amount of reps, and then repeat with your other arm.
